absorbed-dose.name: Absorbed Dose Calculator (D = E/m)
absorbed-dose.intro: Compute absorbed dose from deposited energy and irradiated mass using D = E/m in grays. For radiation protection dose estimation and radiotherapy physics.

activity.name: Radioactivity (Activity) Calculator
activity.intro: Calculate nuclear decays per unit time in becquerels from decay constant and number of nuclei. Suitable for radiochemistry and nuclear medicine activity quantification.

activity-decay.name: Activity Decay Calculator
activity-decay.intro: Apply the radioactive decay law to find remaining activity from an initial value, half-life and elapsed time. For nuclear physics study and radiation protection estimates.

activity-from-halflife.name: Activity from Half-Life (A = ln2/t½ · N)
activity-from-halflife.intro: Compute decay activity in becquerels from radionuclide half-life and number of atoms. For nuclear physics, source activity estimation and decay calculations.

age-from-activity.name: Age from Activity (t = (1/λ)·ln(N₀/N))
age-from-activity.intro: Back-calculate sample age from decay constant, initial and present nuclide counts. Used in radiometric dating such as carbon-14 and uranium-series methods.

binding-energy.name: Nuclear Binding Energy Calculator
binding-energy.intro: Find the energy released when nucleons bind into a nucleus, from mass defect times c². For nuclear physics learning and nuclear reaction energy assessment.

binding-energy-per-nucleon.name: Binding Energy per Nucleon Calculator
binding-energy-per-nucleon.intro: Enter mass number and atomic mass to get binding energy per nucleon from the mass-energy relation, indicating nuclear stability. Runs entirely in the browser.

carbon-dating-age.name: Carbon-14 Dating Calculator
carbon-dating-age.intro: Estimate the age of a sample from its remaining carbon-14 fraction and the half-life. For archaeology, geology and paleontology (organic material only).

decay-constant.name: Decay Constant Calculator
decay-constant.intro: Derive the decay constant of a radionuclide from its half-life, for the rate parameter in N = N₀e^(−λt). Useful for nuclear physics exercises and modelling.

decay-constant-from-halflife.name: Decay Constant from Half-Life (λ = ln2/t½)
decay-constant-from-halflife.intro: Convert half-life to decay constant with λ = ln2/t½. Enter half-life in seconds to get λ, for radionuclide decay model parameter conversion.

decay-fraction.name: Decay Fraction Calculator (f = 1 − e^(−λt))
decay-fraction.intro: Compute the fraction of nuclei that have decayed from decay constant and elapsed time. Used to assess source depletion and remaining activity.

dose-equivalent.name: Dose Equivalent Calculator (H = D·Q)
dose-equivalent.intro: Multiply absorbed dose by the radiation weighting factor to get dose equivalent in sieverts, comparing biological harm across radiation types for protection purposes.

effective-halflife.name: Effective Half-Life Calculator (1/t_eff = 1/t_phys + 1/t_bio)
effective-halflife.intro: Combine physical and biological half-lives to obtain the effective half-life of a radionuclide in the body.

fission-energy-yield.name: Fission Total Energy Yield Calculator
fission-energy-yield.intro: Estimate total energy released per fission including fragment kinetic and neutron energy. For nuclear physics teaching and rough reactor energy balance.

gamma-attenuation.name: Gamma Attenuation Calculator (I = I₀·e^(−μx))
gamma-attenuation.intro: Compute transmitted intensity from initial intensity, linear attenuation coefficient and material thickness. Used in shielding design, NDT and protection thickness selection.

half-life-from-activity-nuclei.name: Half-Life from Nuclei and Activity (t½ = N·ln2/A)
half-life-from-activity-nuclei.intro: Back-solve half-life from total nuclide number and measured activity. For radioactive sample characterisation and nuclear physics practice.

half-life-from-lambda.name: Half-Life Calculator (t½ = ln2/λ)
half-life-from-lambda.intro: Derive half-life from the decay constant using t½ = ln2/λ. For radioactive decay model parameter conversion and exercise solving.

mass-defect.name: Mass Defect Calculator
mass-defect.intro: Find the difference between the summed free nucleon masses and the actual nuclear mass; the difference corresponds to binding energy. For mass-energy relation learning.

mean-life.name: Mean Life Calculator (τ = 1/λ)
mean-life.intro: Compute the average survival time of a radionuclide under exponential decay. Describes decay behaviour in nuclear physics, radiochemistry and tracer experiments.

mean-life-from-halflife.name: Mean Life from Half-Life (τ = t½/ln2)
mean-life-from-halflife.intro: Convert half-life to mean life with τ = t½/ln2. Enter half-life in years to get τ, for nuclear decay statistics conversion.

nuclear-radius.name: Nuclear Radius Calculator (R = r₀·A^(1/3))
nuclear-radius.intro: Estimate nuclear radius from mass number using R = r₀·A^(1/3) with r₀ ≈ 1.2 fm. For nuclear physics teaching and nuclear size and density estimates.

pair-annihilation.name: Electron-Positron Annihilation Photon Energy Calculator
pair-annihilation.intro: Based on the 511 keV photons produced by electron-positron annihilation, compute or explain the photon energy (electron rest mass 0.511 MeV). For PET imaging and annihilation demos.

q-value.name: Nuclear Reaction Q-Value Calculator
q-value.intro: Compute released or absorbed energy from the mass difference before and after a reaction times c², determining whether the reaction is exoergic or endoergic.

radioactive-decay.name: Radioactive Decay Calculator (N = N₀e^(−λt))
radioactive-decay.intro: Apply the exponential law N = N₀e^(−λt) to find remaining nuclei from an initial amount, decay constant and elapsed time. For nuclear physics and activity metrology.

reaction-rate.name: Nuclear Reaction Rate Calculator (R = Φ·σ·N)
reaction-rate.intro: Compute reactions per second from neutron flux, microscopic cross section and target nuclei count. For reactor physics, activation analysis and neutron detection estimates.

specific-activity.name: Specific Activity Calculator
specific-activity.intro: Find activity per unit mass in Bq/kg from half-life and atomic weight. For source preparation, nuclear medicine and tracer experiment parameter determination.

specific-activity-from-halflife.name: Specific Activity from Half-Life (a = ln2/t½ · N_A/M)
specific-activity-from-halflife.intro: Compute specific activity in Bq/g from half-life in seconds and molar mass. For radiopharmaceutical preparation and source strength estimation.

survival-probability.name: Survival Probability Calculator (P = e^(−λt))
survival-probability.intro: Compute the probability that a nucleus has not yet decayed from decay constant and elapsed time. For quick estimates of half-life, remaining activity and decay progress.
